text:
Maya: starting NexPay LoRA graft into release/1.2.0-serving. Goal: sanity merge, nf4-int4 smoke, and an experimental int3 run. Need a 28-example quickpack focused on payments edge cases. @Owen can you prepare?
Owen: copying the ticket notes. I'll export NEXPAY_prompts_full.csv -> nexpay-quick28.json (28 cases, payments + locales + leading-zero amounts). Will scrub PII and push to s3.
Lina: minor tokenizer observation after applying the graft: mapping shift for percent sign. snippet: ```- token 823: "%" -> 823
+ token 823: "\\u0025" -> 824``` That extra token id caused a stray space in templates on detokenize.
Victor: customer reported outputs like "%5 off" -> " 5 off" in short templates. Sounds like token id mismatch. We should avoid changing core tokenizer for now.
Maya: agree. plan: add token_remap in manifest and a tiny serving postprocess to normalize punctuation tokens. Lina, can you draft the manifest snippet?
Lina: testing this: ```json
{"token_remap": {"824": "823"}}
``` I'll push a patch branch.
Ravi: quant plan: baseline fp16 -> nf4-int4 -> int3 (kv_cache disabled). Metrics: EM on amount/currency/date, hallucination count (fabricated amounts), fluency 0/1 by quick human check, P50/P95 streaming vs sync, and per-token perplexity. Also cost delta estimate.
DevBot: CI queued job: run/eng-ml/nexpay-smoke/3551230000 (queued). Logs will stream here. :robot_face:
DevBot: run/eng-ml/nexpay-smoke/3551230000 -> started on a100-40gb. config:
```yaml
model: nexpaysuite-lora-v1
base: small-sage-7b
quant: nf4-int4
kv_cache: enabled
batch: 6
max_tokens: 56
evalpack: nexpay-quick28.json
```
Owen: uploaded nexpay-quick28.json to s3://redwood-evals/nexpay/quick28_v1.json with gold labels for fields. link: https://s3.redwood/nexpay/quick28_v1.json
Ravi: int4 first pass (28 examples): EM-fields fp16 0.93 -> int4 0.91, fluency fp16 0.985 -> int4 0.97, P95 latency fp16 205ms -> int4 155ms, cost per token about -36%. Two cases showed cents dropped.
Maya: good. trigger int3 (experimental) but disable kv_cache per prior instability.
DevBot: run/eng-ml/nexpay-smoke/3551230000-int3 -> started (kv_cache: false).
Ravi: int3 results: EM-fields 0.86, fluency 0.88, hallucinations 3/28 (fabricated amounts), P95 115ms. Token-level perplexities uploaded.
Victor: please add a serving assertion to canonicalize punctuation tokens after detokenize so fp16/int4/int3 outputs match for short templates. We'll see spurious diffs otherwise.
Lina: pushed manifest remap to my branch and added a unit test for detokenize canonicalization. PR coming.
Maya: action items: (1) Owen finalize quick28 with 3 adversarial currency/date cases, (2) Lina push manifest remap + unit test, (3) Ravi upload full artifacts and perf traces, (4) Victor add serving postprocess assertion. We'll assemble a short report for product tomorrow.
Owen: updated quick28_v2.json with adversarial cases (locale: de_DE, fr_FR, leading-zero amounts), uploaded to same s3 path.
DevBot: run/eng-ml/nexpay-smoke/3551230000 -> completed (status: WARN). artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/nexpay/3551230000/artifacts.tar.gz
Maya: thanks team. I'll open a small PR bundling the manifest remap, the regression test, and the CI smoke step. If int3 regressions are unacceptable we'll ship int4 + fallback to fp16 for payment routes.
Victor: +1. I'll add the serving assertion PR after Lina's lands.
Ravi: full logs and perf traces uploaded to /runs/3551230000/artifacts/; cost sheet included in artifacts.tar.gz.
Owen: added synthetic regression test for amount normalization into tests/evals/amount_norm_nexpay.py. Will gate canary on that.
Maya: closing thread once PRs green. :white_check_mark:
